reports.title: Murphy Oil Corporation Announces Third Quarter Results

lines: Capital Expenditures (CAPEX) - CAPEX during the third quarter was $422 million, in line with our guidance.
Full-year 2026 CAPEX guidance remains at a midpoint of $1.55 billion, consistent with what we communicated in our second quarter update.
Even with that step-up, we expect full-year LOE toward the lower end of our previously guided $10 to $12 per BOE range, a credit to the discipline and efficiency of our operations teams.
